In Path of Exile 1: Covens of Umbra, we’re introducing two new gems and making changes to some of the existing ones.

We’ve prepared the gem data at level 20 with 20% quality for all new and changed gems. Check them out!

New Gems



Updated Gems



Flame Link


Modified
  • New: Linked target gains 219 to 329 Added Fire Damage
  • Old: Linked target gains 169 to 254 Added Fire Damage
  • New: Linked target gains Added Fire Damage equal to 3% of your Maximum Life
  • Old: Linked target gains Added Fire Damage equal to 5% of your Maximum Life
Show DifferencesHide Differences

Transfusion Support


Added
  • A Minion within 6 metres gains a Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charge for every 400 Life you spend on Upfront Costs with Supported Spells

Removed
  • A nearby Minion gains a Soul for every 200 Life you spend on Upfront Costs with Supported Spells

New: Supports spells. Does not support instant or blessing spells.

Old: Supports non-blessing spells.
